entries.en: Added `DISABLE_INTERLEAVED_THINKING` to give users the option to opt out of interleaved thinking.
entries.zh: 添加了`DISABLE_INTERLEAVED_THINKING`，让用户可以选择退出交错思维。

entries.en: Improved model references to show provider-specific names (Sonnet 3.7 for Bedrock, Sonnet 4 for Console)
entries.zh: 改进模型引用：显示各提供商的专用名称（Bedrock 上显示 Sonnet 3.7，Console 上显示 Sonnet 4）

entries.en: Updated documentation links and OAuth process descriptions
entries.zh: 更新了文档链接和 OAuth 流程说明
